name: dth-hrh

scripts.glossary:build: python3 -I scripts/glossary/build_glossary.py library/twg-glossary-2026-09-29/HWF_registry_DTH_Glossary_DRAFT.xlsx glossary && bun run kg:blocks
scripts.review:anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-hrh --library twg-outline-2026-10-02 --source library/twg-outline-2026-10-02/HWF_Registry_DTH_Outline.md --source-label "the TWG manuscript outline it was seeded from"
scripts.check:review-anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-hrh --library twg-outline-2026-10-02 --source library/twg-outline-2026-10-02/HWF_Registry_DTH_Outline.md --source-label "the TWG manuscript outline it was seeded from" --check

_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as smart-ra and folio-assistant list them: they import each other by package name (@litlfred/cat-harness-tools, ...), and nothing publishes those packages, so a mount resolves them only through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out. Without this, fhir-harness's scripts could not find @litlfred/cat-harness-tools and check:review-anchors, site:document and the CI publish failed (dth-hrh#41).
